ai.sum: Leaders of Brazil and Türkiye told the COP31 climate summit in Antalya that wars and trade disputes must not distract from climate action.

items.title: Turkey-Greece maritime spat threatens to spill into EU summit
items.summary: ATHENS — A controversial maritime border deal between Libya and Turkey has riled Greece, annoyed the European Union — and could intrude on Friday’s EU leaders’ summit. Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis will raise the issue during the informal meeting of EU leaders in Dublin, according to a senior official in Athens who spoke on condition […]

ai.sum: Greece plans to raise the Libya-Turkey maritime border deal at the EU leaders' informal summit in Dublin, as the deal irritates Athens and Brussels.

items.title: Campers face eviction from Governor’s Beach in Limassol
items.summary: Some 330 families living in caravans at the Governor’s Beach campsite in Limassol have been told to leave, MPs on the House refugee committee heard on Tuesday, with around 102 of them using the caravans as permanent homes. Notices have been posted on doors by the Turkish Cypriot Properties Management Service, which says the site […]

ai.sum: About 330 families living in caravans at Governor's Beach in Limassol have been told to leave by the Turkish Cypriot authority.
